node.title: Re^4: LibXML setNodeName error
node.author: geddie2001
node.doctext: I've noticed a new issue. If the value of the name attribute contains the character "{" then I receive the error: bad name at replaceelementname.pl line 8. There may be other characters that causes this error as well. Any help would be appreciated. If I have to drop XML::LibXML completely, that is okay.
